* Delivery windows: The Fleet Visibility package does not have specific delivery windows, but it can alert operations staff as soon as a shipment crosses a delay threshold. [5]
* Rollout timeline: The typical rollout timeline for the Fleet Visibility package is four to six weeks, including two weeks for carrier feed integration, one to two weeks for configuring per-customer alert thresholds, and one to two weeks for user acceptance testing before go-live. [7]

Overall, the Fleet Visibility package has a more flexible delivery timeline, while the farm-supply delivery windows are more rigid and dependent on the type of order and the need to maintain the cold chain.
